member.label: Probable ribonucleotide transport ATP-binding protein mkl

original_exception.exception_reason: Mkl/MceG is the shared ATPase of the mycobacterial Mce1 and Mce4 transporters, which import host fatty acids and cholesterol respectively; neither substrate is a phospholipid, and the protein has no phospholipid-transport evidence of its own. It is annotated to cholesterol import by IDA (MTBBASE). The generic GO:0006869 is the correct term for it.

supported_by.supporting_text: Fatty acids and cholesterol are imported across the Mtb cell wall via the dedicated Mce1 and Mce4 transporters, respectively.
